summary: Admin Profile feature fully tested. All backend APIs (8/8 tests passed) and frontend UI working correctly. Profile Editor section in Admin Panel successfully displays, pre-fills, and updates admin name and client_name.
passed_tests: Admin login returns client_name and client_id in response
GET /api/auth/me returns client_name and client_id for admin
PUT /api/admin/profile updates name and client_name successfully
PUT /api/admin/profile allows partial updates (only name or only client_name)
PUT /api/admin/profile returns 400 when no data provided
Valet login also returns client_name and client_id
Profile data persists correctly in database
Frontend Admin Panel shows 'My Profile' section with correct fields
Frontend pre-fills existing name and client_name values from /api/auth/me
Frontend 'Save Profile' button calls PUT /api/admin/profile successfully
Frontend shows success toast 'Profile updated successfully!' after save
seed_data_creation: None - used existing admin and valet accounts
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Profile feature is complete and tested. The Admin Panel at /admin route has a 'My Profile' section with data-testid='admin-profile-card', 'admin-profile-name', 'admin-profile-client-name', and 'admin-profile-save-btn'. The client_name appears in WhatsApp messages sent to customers when vehicles are parked.
